aarti.tek: The āratī of Śrī Sāī, the revered Guru,
ever supreme bliss, the best of gods,
and takes away sorrow, grief, trouble and fear.
aarti.pad1: and by miracles showed the truth.
So many devotees came to his feet,
and they found lasting happiness and peace.
aarti.pad2: As is the feeling one holds in the mind,
so is the experience one receives.
Whoever applies the Guru's udī to the body,
aarti.pad3: gains an everlasting reward in the world.
One who offers worship and service on Thursday
aarti.pad4: He gives darśana in the form of Rāma, Kṛṣṇa and Hanumān, as each knows him in the mind.
and having had his darśana, they gain the fruit they wish for.
aarti.pad5: Say: victory to the Avadhūta Guru!
dwelling at home, he finds happiness and blessing.
